observation.command: cd /workspace/project && for u in "https://cloider.com/pricing" "https://cloider.com/docs" "https://cloider.com/api/pricing" "https://cloider.com/api/plans"; do printf "%-40s " "$u"; curl -s -o /tmp/c.html -w "[%{http_code}] " --max-time 25 "$u"; grep -oiE "(\\\$[0-9.]+ ?(/|per) ?(mo|month|hour|hr|gb|vcpu)|free tier|trial)" /tmp/c.html 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -6 | tr '\n' ' '; echo; done
